# Freelancer Tax Pack: Schedule C, SE tax and quarterly payments in one page

> Free year-end tax pack for freelancers: pulls your invoices, expenses and mileage from this browser, then shows Schedule C net profit, self-employment tax, a 2026 federal estimate, quarterly payments still due and the 1099-NEC list. No account, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
